🌴 SURVIVOR 50: OFFICIAL RULES 🌴

Trades: Allowed throughout. Counter offers encouraged. Trade entire teams if you want!

Steals: ONE Pre-Merge, ONE Post-Merge (before final 5). Use it or lose it.

Immunity: Immune teams and individuals cannot be stolen that week.

Stacking: Click Idols/Advantages multiple times to stack them (1, 2, or 3). Click again to reset to 0.

🌟 ICON GLOSSARY (HOVER FOR NAMES)

🟫 / 📿 : Immunity. Locks position.
🗿 : Hidden Idol (Stackable).
📜 : Advantage/Extra Vote (Stackable).
🔥 : Active. Snuff (💨) to eliminate.

💾 SAVE YOUR CHANGES

1. Download updated board. 2. Save as index.html. 3. Upload to GitHub/Drive.
